name: Martha
bio: Martha welcomed Jesus into her house in a village and busied herself serving, while her sister Mary sat at Jesus's feet listening to him. When Martha complained that Mary had left her to serve alone, Jesus gently told her that Mary had chosen the one necessary thing, which would not be taken from her (Luke 10:38-42). When her brother Lazarus fell ill and died, Martha went out to meet Jesus as soon as she heard he was coming, telling him that her brother would not have died had he been there, yet affirming her faith that whatever Jesus asked God would be granted; when Jesus told her that he was the resurrection and the life, she confessed, "I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God," before going to call her sister Mary. At the tomb, when Jesus ordered the stone removed, Martha objected that Lazarus had been dead four days and would already smell, but Jesus raised him anyway (John 11:1-44).
